title: Auto-Renewal Disclosure Gap
description: Agents are skipping the required auto-renewal and refund-eligibility disclosure in 21% of cancellation and refund contacts this week, up from a 4% baseline. Process adherence flagged the pattern. It correlates with a November 20 macro update that moved the disclosure from step 3 to step 7. This is regulatory exposure under negative-option and state auto-renewal rules, not just a quality miss.

confidence.rationale: Skip rate is a direct process-adherence measure; the macro-change correlation is anchored to the Nov 20 version timestamp.

title: Repeat Contact Spike, Refunds
description: Customers contacting again within 48 hours rose 29% for refund and billing issues. First contact resolution for refunds dropped to 55%. Root cause: agents are issuing manual workarounds instead of resolving an underlying billing-sync delay logged by IT.

confidence.rationale: Repeat-contact rate is counted from Service Cloud; the IT-incident correlation is confirmed against the Nov 22 sync-delay ticket.

title: Top Performer Burnout Risk
description: 3 of your top 10 rated agents show declining quality scores over 30 days: handle time up, positive sentiment down. They carry the highest-complexity save and migration contacts.

confidence.rationale: Score decline and handle-time rise are direct telemetry over a 30-day window; burnout attribution is a pattern match against prior cases.
